top_signals.title: Trump's Russia diesel deal may offer Putin more than money — and spell trouble for Ukraine
top_signals.summary: Trump's diesel deal may do little for Russia's finances, but it raises bigger questions about Ukraine's leverage, U.S. support and Putin's next moves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Norway's $2 trillion wealth fund was frozen out of major defense companies. That may be about to change
top_signals.summary: Existing ethical rules mean the fund is not permitted to invest in companies like Lockheed Martin and Boeing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Can AI tame a ‘Godzilla’ El Niño?
top_signals.summary: The technology is being used to anticipate everything from forest fires to futures contracts. Some fear that’s a mistake
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
